conflict_checks.repository_search_note: The five source_record_key values were checked against the existing explicit review decisions. No match was found. Existing food.drinks.tea.citron is specific to yuzu/citron tea and does not justify treating other fruit preserves as citron.

held_decisions.reason: Hallabong fruit preserve/tea base is not citron/yuzu tea merely because the retail shelf is 유자차.
Grapefruit preserve/tea base is a fruit-tea preserve product, not yuzu tea.
Lemon preserve/tea base is distinct from existing citron/yuzu tea.
Ginger-lemon preserve is still a fruit/herbal tea-base preserve; ginger is a flavor/blend attribute.
Hallabong tea product belongs with fruit-tea bases rather than the yuzu-specific citron leaf.
